name: Swedenborgian / New Church

citations.excerpt: to the formal organization of the New Jerusalem Church on the 7th of May 1787.

facts.value: Followers of Emanuel Swedenborg, who did not found a church himself

citations.excerpt: Swedenborg himself took no steps to found a church, but having given a new interpretation of Scripture, it was inevitable that those who accepted his doctrine should separate themselves and organize a society in accordance therewith.

facts.value: Followers of Swedenborg's interpretation of Scripture. The American General Convention was formed at Philadelphia in 1817.

citations.excerpt: the General Convention, which meets annually, was formed at Philadelphia in 1817.
